seed: Skew & distort at Next defaults with no flag changed (the user's approved prototype selection-transform.html, 2026-11-01). A busy screenshot is dropped on a blank picture and picked; the chip by its knob reads Size, Skew & distort, 3D. In Skew & distort the top pill slides the top edge along itself (skew), a corner moves freely (distort), and Shift on a corner keystones, the corner across mirroring it; each drag is one undo step. Escape steps back to Size: the grips sit on the flat box round the reshaped picture with a faint dotted line of the reshape inside, the right pill stretches the box and the reshape keeps its shape on it, the knob turns the reshaped picture, and 3D tips it.

steps.note: the chip by the knob has three choices, Size, Skew & distort and 3D; Skew & distort is on and the tag names the layer
the top pill slid the top edge 100 to the right, the bottom right corner moved freely, Shift on the bottom left keystoned it with the bottom right mirroring, and one undo took back only the keystone

back in Size the grips sit on the flat box round the reshaped picture with a dotted line of the reshape inside; the right pill stretched the box 50 and the reshape kept its shape on it; the knob turned the reshaped picture
3D tipped and swung the turned, reshaped picture; the reshape is untouched
